title: productionPromotion
responsibility: Compares verified preprod and production receipts, checks ancestry and counts commits available to promote.

inputs.name: productionPromotion.root
inputs.description: Absolute Git repository directory whose source and deployment receipts are inspected.

inputs.name: productionPromotion.config
inputs.description: Validated environment mapping whose target identities and promotion boundaries must remain unchanged.

inputs.name: productionPromotion.fingerprint
inputs.description: Hash of the configuration reviewed when the deployment was planned.

outputs.name: productionPromotion
outputs.description: Both verified receipts, their commit distance and reasons that block production promotion.
